_doc: Worked example for the second storage shape: a whole JSON document per file, rather than one record per line. Modelled on the layout OpenCode uses — storage/message/<sessionID>/<messageID>.json, an assistant message whose time is epoch milliseconds and whose session id exists nowhere in the record, only in the directory name. Copy this, change the roots and the paths, add a fixture. Not enabled against any real path on purpose — `roots` points at a directory nobody has. Note what is deliberately absent: `input_is_total`. Whether a vendor's input count already contains its cached count has to be read off that vendor's own code, and guessing it inflates every cost by the size of the user's cache hits.
